summary: Iteration 169 - BioPay V3 (PalmPay/BioPay biometric payment system) VERIFIED. All 26 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend wallet security cards (Payment PIN, BioPay) visible and functional for KYC-verified users. Merchant Dashboard Security tab shows all sections including BioPay Terminals & Sessions management. POS BioPay panel code verified with proper data-testid attributes.

issues: Requires KYC verification to access security features - merchant account (haendler@bidblitz.ae) redirected to KYC page

tests: TestBioPayCustomerProfile::test_biopay_enroll - PASS (palm modality, no biometric image exposed)
Security tab shows all sections (POS Security Center, Approval Queue, Locked Entities, Transaction Limits & Roles, BioPay Terminals & Sessions, Security Reports) - PASS

customer_payment_pin_management.details: GET /api/customer/payment-pin/status, POST /api/customer/payment-pin/set, POST /api/customer/payment-pin/verify all working. Wrong PIN returns generic decline without balance leak.

biopay_customer_profile.details: GET /api/biopay/me returns profiles and sessions. POST /api/biopay/enroll creates palm profile with token_preview only (no encrypted token exposed). POST /api/biopay/verify-self verifies biometric.

biopay_terminal_management.details: GET/POST /api/biopay/terminals for listing and creating terminals. Terminal update works via POST /api/biopay/terminals/{terminal_id}.

biopay_dashboard_and_sessions.details: GET /api/biopay/dashboard returns profiles_total, terminals, sessions. GET /api/biopay/sessions lists sessions without exposing template tokens.

biopay_payment_flow.details: POST /api/biopay/pay handles low-value (approved), high-value (awaiting_app_confirmation), and wrong token (declined) scenarios correctly. No balance or sensitive data exposed on decline.

merchant_security_dashboard.details: GET /api/pos/security/dashboard returns all sections: alerts, fraud_alerts, locked_customers, locked_employees, transaction_limits, approval_queue, role_configs.

role_permissions_management.details: GET /api/pos/security/roles returns roles and all_permissions. POST /api/pos/security/roles/{role_key} updates role permissions.

limits_management.details: GET /api/pos/security/limits returns limit values by scope. POST /api/pos/security/limits updates limits.

approval_queue_management.details: GET /api/pos/security/approvals returns pending approvals. POST /api/pos/security/gift-cards/request creates approval for high-value gift cards. POST /api/pos/security/approvals/{id}/decision rejects/approves.

no_biometric_image_exposure.details: Verified: No template_token_encrypted, token_fingerprint, biometric_image, palm_image, or face_image fields exposed in any API response. Only opaque token_preview shown.

wallet_security_cards_ui.details: Wallet page shows Payment PIN card (data-testid=wallet-payment-pin-card) with status, lock status, set/update/verify inputs. BioPay card (data-testid=wallet-biopay-card) shows PalmPay/FacePay status, enroll/verify inputs, profiles list.

merchant_security_tab_ui.details: Merchant Dashboard Security tab (data-testid=merchant-tab-security) shows: POS Security Center with reports, Approval Queue, Locked Entities (Customers/Employees), Transaction Limits & Roles with Branch selector, BioPay Terminals & Sessions with create terminal form.

critical_code_review_comments: BioPay service correctly stores only encrypted template tokens - no biometric images uploaded or stored
All BioPay API responses correctly mask sensitive data (only token_preview exposed, not full token)
Payment PIN verification returns generic decline message without exposing balance
High-value BioPay payments correctly trigger app confirmation flow
Wrong biometric token correctly returns declined status with fraud visibility
Merchant security dashboard correctly aggregates all security sections
Role permissions and limits are editable through dashboard-backed APIs
POSBioPayPanel has proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
WalletSecurityCards has proper data-testid attributes for Payment PIN and BioPay cards
